translations.web: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
translations.bsb: Rather, as it is written: “Those who were not told about Him will see, and those who have not heard will understand.”
translations.kjv: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
translations.asv: but, as it is written, They shall see, to whom no tidings of him came, And they who have not heard shall understand.
